items.definition:
the state or quality of being irregular
There was an irregularity in the financial records.

an uncertain period of awaiting a decision or resolution; an intermediate state or condition
The project is currently in limbo, awaiting approval.

a formal lunch or a light meal
They attended a business luncheon at the hotel.

the middle part of a period of time, especially a school term or political term of office
Students are preparing for their midterm exams.

the projecting part of the face, including the nose and mouth, of an animal such as a dog or horse; a device fitted over an animal's snout to prevent it from biting
The dog wore a muzzle at the vet's office.

Original Equipment Manufacturer
The company supplies parts to several major OEM clients.

a person or animal that sets the pace
The marathon runner acted as a pacer for his friend.

a distinctive intricate pattern of curved, teardrop-shaped figures
She wore a scarf with a beautiful paisley design.

the male head of a family or tribe
The patriarch of the family made all the important decisions.

the owner of a business or a holder of property
The proprietor of the small shop greeted every customer personally.

an Indian prince or chief
The raja ruled over a vast kingdom.

an increase or revival after a period of little activity, popularity, or occurrence
There has been a resurgence of interest in traditional crafts.

prescription
The doctor wrote an Rx for the patient's medication.

an ancient Indo-Aryan language
Many ancient Indian texts are written in Sanskrit.

dark outline against a lighter background
We could see the silhouette of the mountains against the sunset.

a flexible cord of strong fibrous collagen tissue attaching a muscle to a bone
He pulled a tendon in his leg while running.

the quality of being strong and resilient
His mental toughness helped him overcome the challenge.

a member of a self-appointed group of citizens who undertake law enforcement in their community without legal authority
The town was plagued by a vigilante who sought justice outside the law.

an approximate range or estimate
Can you give me a ballpark figure for the cost?

a person belonging to a tribe or group that is considered uncivilized
The Roman Empire often fought against barbarian tribes.

an organic compound such as sugar or starch
Pasta is a good source of carbohydrates.

a large French country house or castle
They stayed in a beautiful chateau in the Loire Valley.

a group of people living together and sharing possessions and responsibilities
They decided to live in a rural commune.

a room with a glass roof and walls, attached to a house; a school for music or art
She studied piano at the music conservatory.

a digital currency in which transactions are verified and records maintained by a decentralized system
Bitcoin is a well-known cryptocurrency.

commercial transactions conducted electronically on the internet
The growth of ecommerce has transformed retail.

a person or organization that enters a competition or is admitted to a group or market
There were over 100 entrants in the marathon.

a statement that represents something as better or worse than it really is
His story was full of exaggeration.

the body of admirers or supporters of a person, group, or organization
The band has a huge international fanbase.

a complete failure, especially a humiliating or ludicrous one
The party turned into a complete fiasco.

A rounded projection or division, especially of the brain or lung.
The earlobe is the soft, fleshy part at the bottom of the ear.

The act of leaving something out or not including something.
There was a significant omission in the report.

A brown, soil-like material characteristic of boggy, acid ground, consisting of partially decomposed vegetable matter.
Peat is often used as a fuel or in gardening.

The office or position of a priest.
He entered the priesthood after years of study.

A person or machine that harvests crops; a personification of death.
The farmer used a mechanical reaper to cut the wheat.

a famous and successful rock musician
He always dreamed of becoming a rockstar.

the state of being calm, peaceful, and untroubled
The garden offered a place of peace and serenity.

an instance of seeing something, especially something unusual or rare
There was a rare bird sighting near the lake this morning.

a system for detecting objects underwater by emitting sound pulses
Submarines use sonar to navigate and detect other vessels.

a small argument or disagreement
They had a minor spat over who should do the dishes.

a ship equipped for naval warfare
The warship sailed into the harbor for repairs.

one's opponent in a contest, conflict, or dispute
He faced his old adversary in the final round.

the killing or wounding of people, typically during conflict
The conflict resulted in much bloodshed.

a two-wheeled vehicle drawn by horses, used in ancient warfare and racing
The ancient warriors rode into battle in their chariots.

an infectious and often fatal bacterial disease of the small intestine, typically contracted from infected water supplies and causing severe vomiting and diarrhea
Cholera is a serious disease that can spread through contaminated water.

the action or practice of commemorating; a ceremony or celebration
The monument was built in commemoration of the fallen soldiers.

the natural color, texture, and appearance of the skin, especially of the face
She has a fair complexion.

detoxification
She went on a juice detox for a week.

a rough drawing or scribble
He drew a doodle on the napkin during the meeting.

a large building for housing aircraft
The plane was stored in the hangar.

flaw
Every piece of handmade pottery has a slight imperfection.

type of wood
The antique desk was made of solid mahogany.

failure to function
The computer had a serious software malfunction.

one who helps resolve disputes
A neutral mediator was called in to help settle the labor dispute.

subordinate follower
The villain ordered his minions to capture the hero.

optical illusion
In the desert, a mirage can make distant water appear close.

ridicule
His attempt at singing was met with widespread mockery.

a person who plans and directs the route of a ship, aircraft, or other form of transport
The ship's navigator used the stars to guide them.

a small brown European bird known for its beautiful song, especially at night
The sweet song of the nightingale filled the evening air.

an athlete who competes in the Olympic Games
Every Olympian dreams of winning a gold medal.

a sustained and enthusiastic show of appreciation from an audience, especially by clapping
The singer received a standing ovation.

revenge or retribution
He was looking for payback after being cheated.

a resting place for a bird; a type of fish
The bird landed on its perch.

the form, size, and development of a person's body
He had an athletic physique.
